headline: World Cup 2026: Cape Verde’s heroic defeat by Argentina – in pictures
context: Cape Verde and Argentina played out a game for the ages in their last 32 clash as the world champions were twice pegged back by the African side, only to prevail 3-2 in extra time. We take a look at some of the best images from an incredible evening in Miami Continue reading...
